text:
mei: FYI bringing up crescent-v1 (q4a) on the multilingual suite — small but consistent artifact with mixed CJK + Hebrew: closing quotes swap orientation and square brackets sometimes jump across RTL span. attaching a tiny repro and metric summary.

raj: can you paste the exact input and both outputs (fp16 vs q4a)?

mei: yep. config: crescent-v1 q4a-pack, tokenizer=hybrid-unified-2026. repro: mixed zh + he line.
```
input: 我在【新品】下面看到这个: "מה זה המוצר הזה?"
expected fp16 detok: 我在【新品】下面看到这个: "מה זה המוצר הזה?"
q4a detok: 我在】新品【下面看到这个: "מה זה המוצר הזה?"
# note the square brackets reversed around the Chinese segment, and the mirrored quote for the whole span swapped (" -> ”).
```

claire: odd. looks like a bidi/quoting reconciliation bug during detokenize. does the q4a packer introduce alias ids for bracket-like punctuation?

dmitri: quick check: token id stream before detok for that example from fp16 vs q4a-pack:
```
# fp16 ids: [200, 3456, 9876, 1001, 4002, 300]
# q4a ids : [200, 3456, 8221, 1001, 4002, 300]  # 8221 = packed-alias for LEFT_SQUARE_BRACKET
```

dmitri: 8221 appears in the packer alias table and maps back to a canonical '[' in most cases, but when adjacent to RTL runs the detok mirror logic treats it as mirrored and flips position.

mei: metrics: zh->he BLEU baseline (crescent fp16) 18.4, crescent q4a 15.7, delta -2.7. zh->en and he->en stable. run link: https://redwood-internal/eval/28123-crescent-q4a-mixlocale

raj: can you run quick experiments: (A) reencode without aliases (pack disabled) on 2k mixed examples, (B) detok tweak marking alias tokens as 'neutral' in bidi resolver?

claire: also check streaming vs batch detok; streaming pipeline applies incremental bidi resolution and might show different symptom.

dmitri: i'll run A locally now. if A recovers BLEU and fixes bracket placement then root cause is alias <-> bidi interaction.

triage-bot: job triage/bisect/2812345679 queued on runner-12. expected ~25m. details: https://redwood-internal/ci/triage/2812345679

mei: if alias is the culprit, short-term mitigation could be a tokenizer poststep that replaces aliases with explicit codepoints for punctuation in mixed-orientation inputs, long-term change the packer to preserve mirror-neutral property.

raj: make sure to add unit test cases for combinations: CJK bracket + Hebrew/Arabic embedded + streaming/batched detok to avoid regression.

triage-bot: update 1m elapsed 1 job running on runner-12

dmitri: local A result (2k samples): pack disabled -> BLEU recovered to 18.2, bracket flip gone on repro set. B (detok neutral) prototype shows partial recovery (17.9). attaching diff and small token id map: https://redwood-internal/snap/2812345679/diff

mei: thanks. sounds like a clear path. i'll open a fix PR: (1) short-term tokenizer post-normalize mapping for punctuation around RTL spans, (2) longer-term packer change to tag alias tokens with mirror=neutral. PR link: https://redwood-internal/pull/ML-4932

claire: add perf check for detok change (both streaming and batch) and ensure no tokenization latency spike.

raj: great work. once PR is up, let's run full eval and add regression asserts into the multilingual smoke suite.

triage-bot: job complete. summary: pack alias produced mirror semantics -> detok flip. recommended remediation: tokenizer post-normalize + packer tag change.

mei: will follow up with timeline in ML-4932.
